select c.*, uz.dzzmc,rzfs.hzmc as RZFSMC, zwmc.hzmc as ZWMCMC, zwjb.hzmc as ZWJBMC, (case c.ZZJZQK when '1' then '专职' when '2' then '兼职' else '' end) as ZZJZQKMC, uspoint.LDRYLXDMC,jszw.hzmc as JSZWMC, u.ZWMC as XZZWMC from ZZ_BZCYXX c inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX z on c.dzzdm= z.dzzdm inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB dzzfb on c.DZZDM=dzzfb.DZZDM and c.JC=dzzfb.LDJTJC left join zzzd_rzfs rzfs on c.rzfs = rzfs.bm left join Zzzd_zwmc zwmc on c.zwmc = zwmc.bm left join Zd_dzzwjbm zwjb on c.gzwjb = zwjb.bm inner join VM_RYJBXX u on c.RYBM=u.RYBM inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX uz on u.SZDZBDM= uz.dzzdm left join RS_RYJBXXFB fb on u.RYBM=fb.RYBM left join zd_zyjszwdm jszw on u.xjszwmc=jszw.bm left join VW_USERCONTACTPOINT uspoint on c.RYBM=uspoint.RYBM where 1=1
and c.dzzdm like concat('%',#{dzzdm},'%')
and c.jc like concat('%',#{ldjtjc},'%')
and z.dzzmc like concat('%',#{dzzmc},'%')
and c.xm like concat('%',#{xm},'%')
and c.zwmc like concat('%',#{zwmc},'%')
and c.rzfs = #{rzfs}
and z.ZZLB in('611','200','271')
and z.ZZLB not in('611','200','271')
and SUBSTR(c.dzzdm,1,12) in(select dzzdm from ZZ_DZZFBQK where zzfb= #{zzfbType})
/*所属党组织代码*/
and c.dzzdm =#{ssdzzdm}
and c.RYBM = #{rybm}
order by u.XMPY,u.RYJBXXBS

select zzlb.BM,zzlb.HZMC,ifnull(t1.count,0) as count from ZZZD_ZZLBDMNEW zzlb left join ( select fb.ZZLB,count(1) as count from ZZ_ZZQKXX zz inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on zz.DZZDM = fb.dzzdm left join ( select distinct bz.DZZDM,bz.GJJMRQ from ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb inner join ZZ_BZJCXX bz on fb.DZZDM = bz.DZZDM and fb.LDJTJC = bz.LDJTJC where bz.GJJMRQ is not null ) t on zz.DZZDM = t.DZZDM where 1=1
and zz.dzzdm like concat('%',#{dzzdm}'%')
and ((t.GJJMRQ is not null and SUBSTR(t.GJJMRQ,1,4)=#{year}) or (zz.JLDZZRQ is not null and SUBSTR(zz.JLDZZRQ,1,4)=#{year}))
group by fb.ZZLB ) t1 on zzlb.BM = t1.ZZLB where 1=1 and zzlb.BM in ('100','300','400') order by zzlb.bm
